title: Resolution urging Congress to require input on helicopter tour routes
summary: This resolution calls on Congress to pass and the president to sign the Communities Before Tourism Act, which would require the Federal Aviation Administration and National Park Service to consult with communities under air-tour routes before making voluntary agreements with helicopter operators. It cites a 2,300% rise in helicopter noise complaints over five years, with 20,553 complaints in 2025, and health and pollution concerns linked to frequent flights.
